messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposing a coordinated version bump for API + runtime + console + SDKs next Wednesday. Target tag: v2.3.0. Cutoff for code + changelog: Tue 18:00 PT. Can owners confirm any outstanding cherrypicks or migrations?
ryan: +1 from release side. I'll open the coordinated release PR on Monday and include the rollout checklist. Can we keep the API change strictly non-breaking?
devin: Runtime owner here — no breaking changes planned. Need to land the kernel selector fallback fix (PR #3421). ETA: EOD Friday. I'll prepare a backport candidate.
lee: Console: small UX tweak for model selector (non-breaking). Will add changelog blurb. Quick question: should the console package.json pin to 2.3.0 in the release branch or use ^2.3.0?
maria: prefer pin in the release commit to avoid transitive surprises; you can relax to ^ after the release.
ryan: @lee please pin for the release bundle.
sam: SDKs (JS + Py) need a compat shim for the telemetry header. PRs exist but depend on the runtime fallback. If runtime slips I'll gate the shim behind a feature flag.
priya: QA: we'll need a short smoke matrix covering auth, model selection, streaming, embeddings. I'll also ask infra to freeze changes during the verification window — last time infra drift caused flakes.
oncall-bot: [auto] Scheduled maintenance window Tue 23:00-23:30 PT for infra patching.
qa-bot: Test matrix template posted: https://go/release-tests/matrix — assigning to @priya and @sam for automation.
devin: Quick cherrypick helper for runtime if useful:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/v2.3-cherry runtime/main
git cherry-pick <commit-hash>
```
maria: please include commit hashes and PR numbers in the coordinated PR description. Also include changelog bullets, e.g.:
```
- runtime: kernel-fallback to avoid OOM on short sequences (#3421)
- sdk: telemetry shim to align with new header format (#278)
- console: model selector UX clarifications (#1149)
```
lee: console release branch created: release/console-v2.3 — I'll add the changelog entry and pin the package in that branch, then ping for review.
sam: JS SDK: bump to 2.3.0 and prepare publish PR; will leave feature flag until runtime merges. Py SDK PR ready too.
ryan: schedule: I'll cut the release tag Wed 09:00 PT, run canary for 2 hours, then promote. Rollback plan: revert tag + restore prior routing if critical issues.
maria: last ask — everyone drop final status here by Tue 19:00 PT so I can freeze the changelog and finalize the release PR.
priya: will post automation run results and pass/fail summary by Tue 19:00 PT.
devin: runtime backport commit: ab12f3c. Marked PR as backport-ready.
lee: release PR prepared locally, will push and open for review Monday morning.
sam: PRs: #412 (JS), #413 (Py) — feature-flag present; awaiting runtime merge.
maria: thanks all — I'll assemble the coordinated PR Monday and tag owners for review. :thumbsup:
